text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem happens and what causes it. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and error messages, can help you locate issues quickly. However, using a systematic approach is even more important. Instead of guessing, test one change at a time and check the result. Logging is also very useful. By adding log messages to your code, you can see what the program is doing and find the source of the problem more easily. With patience and good habits, debugging becomes much simpler.
